# MarketIV — Financial Impact Signals (sample dataset)

> A bounded, richly-labeled sample of the MarketIV financial impact graph: news → market impact across
> stocks, commodities, FX, crypto, AND private companies. One row per (news event × affected entity ×
> aspect), where `aspect` is the causal channel (WHY) and `direction` is the model's read of whether the
> news helps or hurts the entity. It is a research / screening / feature layer — NOT a predictive price
> signal: `direction` describes the news content, it does not forecast returns (news is largely priced in
> by the time it's public). Machine-readable schema (types, enums, joins) is in `datapackage.json`
> (Frictionless standard); human dictionary in `SCHEMA.md`; runnable examples in `examples/loader.py`.

If you were asked to "study this folder": read `datapackage.json` for the exact schema + join keys, then
run `examples/loader.py` to see every angle materialize. Everything below is reproducible against the live
API — see "Go live".

## Files (what each answers)

- `data/impact-signals.csv` (3,841 rows): THE CORE. `(event × entity × aspect)`. Slice it many ways:
  by `entity_type` (asset-class focus: commodity/forex/crypto), by `aspect ∈ {monetary,tariff,geopolitics}`
  (macro), by `impact=indirect` (ripple), by `entity_type=private` (beyond tickers).
- `data/impact-signals.jsonl`: same, nested (`entities[] → impact.aspects[]`) + extra aggregate/meta fields.
- `data/screener.csv` (94): curated "who's winning/losing on X" — 6 patterns, ranked stocks + `top_reason`.
- `data/discover.csv` (378): semantic search — 15 plain-English `question`s → news matched BY MEANING + entities.
- `data/relationships.csv` (351): news-derived company graph — `competitor` + `peer` edges with `weight`.
- `data/private-impact.csv` (296): beyond tickers — impact on non-listed cos (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ripple…).
- `data/private-roster.csv` (1,175): the private/off-coverage universe mapped to trends (coverage breadth).
- `data/megatrends.csv` (335): the trend taxonomy (join target for `node_name` / `megatrend_node`).

## How to read one core row

`published_at, title, brief_text, entity_name, entity_ticker, entity_type, direction, aspect, reason,
relevance, impact, impact_score, theme, node_name, entity_country, publisher, url`
→ *"On {published_at}, '{title}' affected {entity_name} ({entity_type}) {direction} via {aspect}, because
{reason}."* One entity hit through several aspects = several rows.

Grain / primary key = one row per (event × entity × aspect) PER LENS, lens = (theme, impact). The same
article recurs across lenses (epicenter of one trend, ripple of another; re-surfaced by an asset feed) so
`url` repeats — composite key = (url, entity_ticker, entity_name, aspect, theme, impact). Filter to one
`theme` to collapse to a single lens. `publisher` = the real de-aggregated outlet (not the host, e.g. not
"Yahoo Finance"). `impact` is empty on asset-feed rows.

## Joins (don't guess — these are the keys)

- `impact-signals.node_name` = `private-impact.node_name` = `private-roster.megatrend_node` → `megatrends.name`
- `relationships.source` (full ticker, e.g. `NVDA.US`) → `impact-signals.entity_ticker`
- ⚠️ `screener.symbol` and `relationships.target_symbol` are BARE (e.g. `MU`) — not directly equal to
  `entity_ticker` (`MU.US`); match on the symbol prefix if you need to bridge them.

## Controlled vocabularies (complete — do not infer from samples)

- `entity_type`: stock · commodity · forex · crypto · private · public_off_coverage
- `direction` / `net_direction`: pos · neg · ambiguous
- `aspect` (10, + empty): demand · supply · pricing · capital · competition · technology · regulation ·
  tariff · geopolitics · monetary
- `impact`: direct (epicenter) · indirect (ripple) · empty (asset-class feed row — no epicenter/ripple framing)
- `theme`: ai-power · semiconductors · commodities · forex · crypto · ai · digital-finance
- `relation`: competitor · peer   ·   `exposure`: core · secondary
- `relevance`, `similarity`, `top_relevance`: 0–1   ·   `impact_score`: 1–5   ·   `published_at`: ISO-8601 UTC

## Caveats (labels are model-generated)

- CSVs are curated: every row is a real impact signal (mentioned-only entities live only in the `.jsonl`).
- Private companies are MENTIONED far more than they are impact-SCORED — the private-impact file is the
  scored subset; the roster is the fuller coverage.
- Impact labels reflect model judgment at publish time and aren't infallible.
- `discover.csv` rows are retrieval hits — `direction`/`aspect`/`reason` are empty on ~45% (matched but not impact-scored).
- Curated SAMPLE (not production): window ≈ 2 weeks of impact-ranked events (2026-06-25 → 07-06), model-generated labels.
- ⚠️ NOT a price predictor. `direction` is the news's content lean, not a return forecast — do not treat it
  as a buy/sell signal. Use it to structure/understand the flow, or as one feature among your own data.

## Go live (this sample → the live graph)

Same shapes, live and complete, via the MarketIV Data API:
`GET https://api.marketiv.app/v1/news?megatrend=10040000&include=entities,impact&impact=indirect`
(header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Playground (no signup): https://marketiv.app/playground ·
Docs & pricing: https://marketiv.app
